h1: Kantary House Bangkok — 4-Star Serviced Apartments with Full Kitchen, Near The Mall Bangkapi
intro: When you need a real base in Bangkok's eastern residential belt — somewhere with space to breathe, a functioning kitchen, and a washing machine — Kantary House Hotel & Serviced Apartments is the address to know. Tucked into Soi Ramkhamhaeng 42 in Hua Mak-Bangkapi, this 4-star property offers studio suites from a genuine 42 m², one-bedroom suites at 67 m², and two-bedroom configurations for families and groups. Every unit comes with a full kitchen, private washing machine, and a separate living area. Add an outdoor pool, sauna, gym, and daily breakfast buffet at The Orchard Restaurant — all within 15–20 minutes of Suvarnabhumi Airport. Score: 8.8 from 319 reviews on Trip.com. From approx. ฿1,500/night.

body.html: Kantary House is not a hotel in the traditional sense — it's a place designed around actually living, not just sleeping. Each unit is fitted with a kitchen counter, microwave, refrigerator, private washing machine, and a proper sitting area separate from the bedroom. The studio suites measure a comfortable 42 m² — noticeably more floor space than most Bangkok hotels at a comparable price point. Step up to the one-bedroom configuration at 67 m² and you get a fully separate bedroom, making it sensible for couples who want a bit more breathing room or business travellers on extended assignments.

Location deserves an honest read. Ramkhamhaeng 42 is not Bangkok's tourist epicentre, and that's genuinely part of the value proposition. Bangkapi-Hua Mak is a dense, functional residential-and-mall district on Bangkok's eastern fringe. The Mall Lifestyle Store Bangkapi — with the indoor HarborLand waterpark — is about a 5-minute drive. MRT Yellow Line's Lam Sali interchange is a short Grab ride away, connecting onwards to the Blue Line and the rest of the city. Crucially, Suvarnabhumi Airport is just 15–20 minutes by road — a fact that repeatedly shows up in guest reviews as a reason for choosing this property.

"The room is spacious with a working kitchen and washing machine. Staff at the front desk are genuinely helpful. Breakfast had more variety than I expected — the omelette station was a nice touch. Felt more like a home than a hotel."

Staff quality is the most consistent thread running through positive reviews. Guests describe the front desk team as friendly, responsive, and genuinely good at solving problems. The breakfast buffet at The Orchard Restaurant is singled out in many reviews — a varied spread including a live egg station, fresh fruit, and Asian and international options, earning praise from guests who admitted it exceeded expectations. The outdoor pool and hot tub are clean and well-maintained, described as a pleasant spot that never gets crowded — a bonus for a property of this scale.

The property also offers a sauna, fitness room, massage facilities, Executive Lounge with complimentary food and beverages, two meeting rooms, and free in-building parking. For long-stay guests, the kitchen and in-unit washer are transformative — multiple reviewers noted that cooking a few meals per week and handling laundry in-room cut their daily costs substantially compared to a standard hotel setup. Free Wi-Fi covers all units and common areas.

Balanced against the positives: some reviewers flag that parts of the property are showing their age. Furniture in older units can look worn, and certain hallways have reportedly had dust accumulation between cleans. Gym equipment has drawn some criticism for needing maintenance — yoga mats in particular. Wi-Fi signal quality is inconsistent, with rooms further from the lobby sometimes experiencing weaker connectivity. Drink prices at the restaurant have surprised a few guests on the high side. None of these are deal-breakers for most stays, but worth knowing if you're coming for an extended booking.

Overall, Kantary House Bangkok earns its 8.8 score from a clear majority of satisfied guests. It's a strong option for business travellers, families, medical visitors to the eastern Bangkok hospitals, and anyone transiting through Suvarnabhumi who wants apartment-style comfort without paying Sukhumvit rates. Rooms from approx. ฿1,500/night for a 42 m² studio represent genuine value for the space and amenities on offer — just go in knowing this is a neighbourhood property, not a city-centre one.

honestSummary: Kantary House Bangkok delivers on its core promise: spacious apartment-style suites at 4-star service levels in eastern Bangkok, at a price well below what you'd pay downtown. Staff quality and the apartment format are the real strengths. The trade-offs — some ageing furniture, an off-centre location, variable Wi-Fi — are real but manageable.
honestChecks: If you plan to spend most of your time exploring Siam, Sukhumvit, or the old city — Ramkhamhaeng 42 will add significant commuting time daily. You'll need Grab or MRT Yellow Line transfers → consider a hotel closer to BTS/MRT mainlines instead.

If you're sensitive to room condition and dated decor — some units have visibly older furnishings. Specify when booking that you want a recently refurbished room, or choose a one-bedroom suite which tends to be in better condition.
If reliable high-speed Wi-Fi is non-negotiable for remote work — signal varies by room location. Request a room on a lower floor near the lobby, and have a mobile hotspot as backup.

tips.title: Request a recently renovated unit
tips.body: Mention in your booking notes or at check-in that you'd prefer a recently refurbished unit — the difference in furniture condition is noticeable and worth asking for, especially on a multi-night stay.

tips.title: Ideal as a Suvarnabhumi pre-flight base
tips.body: Suvarnabhumi Airport is just 15–20 minutes by road. Using Kantary House for an early-morning flight or late-night arrival is significantly cheaper than airport-adjacent hotels with a fraction of the space.

tips.title: Don't skip The Orchard breakfast
tips.body: The breakfast buffet consistently outperforms expectations — live egg station, fresh fruit, Thai staples and international options. Available from 5:30 AM, which is particularly useful for early-departure days.

tips.title: Use MRT Yellow Line or Khlong Saen Saep express boat
tips.body: MRT Yellow Line's Lam Sali station is a short Grab ride away, connecting to the Blue Line junction. The Khlong Saen Saep express boat from a nearby pier is even faster into the city centre on clear mornings.

faqTitle: FAQ — Kantary House Hotel & Serviced Apartments, Bangkok

faq.q: Where is Kantary House Bangkok located and what is nearby?
faq.a: Kantary House is located at 14 Soi Ramkhamhaeng 42, Hua Mak, Bang Kapi, Bangkok. The Mall Lifestyle Store Bangkapi (with HarborLand indoor waterpark) is about 5 minutes by car. Suvarnabhumi Airport is 15–20 minutes. The MRT Yellow Line Lam Sali station and Khlong Saen Saep express boat pier are both reachable by a short Grab ride.

faq.q: How much does Kantary House Bangkok cost per night and what room types are available?
faq.a: Rates start from approximately ฿1,500/night for a Studio Suite (42 m²). One-Bedroom Suites (67 m²) are around ฿2,200. Two-Bedroom Suites (90 m²) around ฿3,200. Every unit includes a full kitchen and private washing machine — a significant value add versus a standard hotel room.

faq.q: Is Kantary House Bangkok good for families?
faq.a: Yes — it's particularly well-suited for families. The one- and two-bedroom suites offer separate bedrooms and a full kitchen, so you can prepare meals in-room and manage laundry privately. The outdoor pool is family-friendly and the property's proximity to The Mall Bangkapi (HarborLand waterpark) is a bonus for families with children.

faq.q: What facilities does Kantary House Bangkok have?
faq.a: The property offers an outdoor pool, hot tub, sauna, gym, massage room, Executive Lounge, The Orchard Restaurant (breakfast from 5:30 AM), two meeting rooms, and free in-building parking. Every suite has a full kitchen, microwave, fridge, and private washing machine.

faq.q: How far is Kantary House Bangkok from Suvarnabhumi Airport?
faq.a: Approximately 15–20 minutes by car or Grab in normal traffic — making Kantary House one of the more practical 4-star serviced apartment options near Suvarnabhumi. It's a popular choice for early-morning departures, late-night arrivals, or transit stays between international flights.
